The prior finding is now resolved: all four substantive ledger files are covered by digest_manifest.json; the manifest’s SHA-256 is published in the report and matches; evidence/report_digest.txt publishes the exact report SHA-256 before review and also matches; and all 235 manifest entries re-hash successfully. I deliberately do not require a digest of the pure digest-carrier sidecar itself: its only asserted information is independently verified by hashing the report, and requiring another carrier to hash it would create an infinite regress rather than protect a deliverable.
